chunks: Announcing happy news and warnings. And yet most of them are averse and do not listen,

key_terms.بَشِيرًا: A bringer of good news or glad tidings
key_terms.فَأَعْرَضَ: And they turned away / were averse
key_terms.نَذِيرًا: A warner or one who gives warning of punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Bashir and Nadhir in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of prophetic and imamic authority, where the Imams serve as the living embodiment of the 'glad tidings' and 'warning' roles established by the Prophet. The phrase 'they do not hear' is interpreted not merely as physical deafness but as a spiritual blindness resulting from their deliberate aversion (istikbar), a theme frequently linked to the fate of those who rejected Imam Ali (AS) and the Ahl al-Bayt.
